Title: Published-only editor concurrency closure
Purpose: Close the remaining stale-save hole in the published-only editor path by ensuring definition-level concurrency metadata is always present when editing an existing definition without a working draft.
Deliverables: An editor-loading path that always sets `DefinitionConcurrencyToken` when an existing definition is loaded, even if no working draft exists yet.
A direct integration test that simulates a published-only or no-draft state and proves a stale save is rejected.
No weakening of the current working-draft concurrency behavior.
ReviewQuestions: Can an editor for an existing definition still be returned without a definition concurrency token?
Does a stale save now fail in the published-only/no-draft path instead of silently creating a new draft from stale state?
Did the change avoid regressing the normal working-draft concurrency flow?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If any existing-definition editor path still returns a null definition token, fail and reopen this subbundle before continuing.
